title: Will You Ever Look at Me?
short: A Heart-Wrenching Novel of Unseen Love, Toxic Obsession, and the Price of Silence
excerpt: He looked at her every day but never saw her. She wept for him every night but never told him.
description: He sees her every day, but never truly sees her. She loves him silently while he is trapped in a dangerous obsession with another woman.
A heartbreaking story of hidden love, silent sacrifice, and emotional pain, building to the moment a forgotten heart finally demands to be seen. Will he open his eyes before it's too late?
features: A powerful figure enslaved by a toxic obsession
A silent woman who loves deeply but remains invisible
A beautiful lie he worships and protects with everything
A heartbreaking twist that changes everything
benefits: An emotional rollercoaster of suspense and tension
For readers who've ever loved in silence
